description: This file implements a serializer codec for types that implement the ISerializable pattern in .NET. It facilitates serialization and deserialization of such objects, including handling fallback scenarios for unknown exception types. The class manages reflection-based object creation, serialization info processing, and type-specific serializer management within Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: DotNetSerializableCodec
classes.description: Serializer for types implementing the ISerializable pattern, handling their serialization/deserialization logic within Orleans framework.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a field of an object, handling value types and reference types differently, and supporting reference tracking.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes an object value, with special handling for exceptions and value types.

methods.name: ReadFallbackException
methods.description: Deserializes an exception fallback object when the original type cannot be parsed.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads a complex object from the buffer, including handling serialization info and object creation.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Serializes an object, including its serialization info and custom fields.

methods.name: IsSupportedType
methods.description: Checks if a type is supported by this serializer, such as ISerializable or exception types with a serialization constructor.
